selection_rationale: Fixed feasibility frame: age counts for numeric/zero controls, overall and Asian-alone median income for non-computability/interval qualifications, and an age/sex subject table for structural non-applicability. Purposive selection, not ACS prevalence estimation. Fixed after two access probes returned no data; before any observation inspection.
exclusions: Margins of error, comparison significance, unrecognized or inconsistent estimate/annotation pairs. No silent exclusion: unknown pairs block readiness.
readiness_scope: Thresholds justify only preparing a pilot, not statistical power or paper promotion. Natural rendering, manual parser audit, and a model protocol remain required.
